bangla_explanation: Learning materials লিখতে বসে অনেক trainer গুছিয়ে উঠতে পারেন না।
Robert-এর এই model একটা structured approach দেয়, মোট nine steps।
শুরু হয় attention ধরা দিয়ে, শেষ হয় retention and transfer দিয়ে।
মাঝখানে practice, feedback আর assess performance থাকে, তাই শেখা পাকা হয়।

example.en: A welding trainer starts with a short story to gain attention. Then he states the objectives.
example.bn: Welding class শুরুতে একটা ছোট গল্প বলে attention ধরা, তারপর objectives বলা।

mnemonic.text: Gain, Inform, Stimulate, Present, Guide, Elicit, Feedback, Assess, Enhance
mnemonic.explain_bn: শুরুতে মনোযোগ, মাঝে শেখানো আর practice, শেষে assess আর মনে রাখা — এই ক্রমে মনে রাখুন।

items.text: Gain Attention: to orientate and motivate the learner.

cites.quote: Gain Attention - to orientate and motivate the learner

items.text: Inform Learners of Objectives: to guide learners and organize their thoughts.

cites.quote: Inform Learners of Objectives - to guide learners and to assist them to
organize their thoughts around what they are about to learn

items.text: Stimulate Recall of Prior Knowledge: adults learn by linking new learning to what they know.

cites.quote: Stimulate Recall of Prior Knowledge - because adults learn by establishing
relationships with what they know and a new knowledge or skill

items.text: Present the material: in a way that is easy to digest.

cites.quote: Present the material - in a way that appeals to the different learning
references and is easy to digest

items.text: Provide guidance for learning: help integrate new information into existing knowledge.

cites.quote: Provide guidance for learning - by providing opportunities to integrate new
information into their existing knowledge base

items.text: Elicit performance by providing safe opportunities to practice.

cites.quote: Elicit performance by providing safe opportunities to practice

items.text: Provide feedback: to reinforce or correct learning.

cites.quote: Provide feedback - to reinforce or correct learning

items.text: Assess performance: learners gain recognition of their success in learning.

cites.quote: Assess performance - learners should be given the opportunity for
assessment to gain recognition of their success in learning

items.text: Enhance retention and transfer: encourage learners to plan applying what they learnt.

cites.quote: Enhance retention and transfer - by encouraging learner to plan the
application of what they have learnt

short.prompt: Write down the nine steps that can assist you in your writing.
short.modelAnswer:
Robert Gagné's nine steps:
1. Gain Attention
2. Inform Learners of Objectives
3. Stimulate Recall of Prior Knowledge
4. Present the material
5. Provide guidance for learning
6. Elicit performance (safe practice)
7. Provide feedback
8. Assess performance
9. Enhance retention and transfer

keyPoints.text: Gagné's model gives a structured approach to developing your materials.
